verses.en: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.sm: Panapa i nuu ese Sa i le ekalesia Anetioka nisi perofeta ma a'oa'o; 0 Panapa, ma Simeona ua igoa ia Nikeru, ma Lukio le Kurene, o Manaena sa tausia faatasi o ia ma Herota le tupu, atoa ma Saulo.

verses.en: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
verses.sm: O latou o auauna i le ALII ma anapopogi, ona fetalai mai lea o le Agaga Paia, ““Totofi ia mo atu o Panapa ma Saulo i le galuega ua ou valaauina ai i laua.”

verses.en: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
verses.sm: Ona anapopogi lea o i latou ma tatalo, ma faaee o latou lima ia te i laua, ona tuuina atu lea o i laua e 6.

verses.en: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.sm: d O lenei, ua aauina nei tagata e le Agaga Paia, ona o lea o i laua i Selukeia; ua folau atu nai lea mea i Kuperu.

verses.en: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
verses.sm: s Ua i Salamina, ona la folafola ai lea o le afioga a le Atua i sunako O tagata Iutaia; ua auauna foi Ioane ia te i laua.

verses.en: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:
verses.sm: Ua latou soo i le motu, ua oo atu i Pafo, ua iloa ai e i latou le tasi taulaitu, o le perofeta pepelo, o le Iutaia, o Paiesu lona igoa.

verses.en: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
verses.sm: Sa i ai o ia i le suikonesula, o Sekio Paulo, o le tagata faautauta lea; ua aami lenei tagata ia Panapa ma Saulo, ua manao i le fia faalogo i le afioga a le Atua.

verses.en: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
verses.sm: A o Elima le taulaitu, (aua o le uiga lea o lona igoa,) ua tetee mai o ia ia te i laua, ua fia faaliliu ese atu e ia o le suikonesula i le faatuatua.

verses.en: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
verses.sm: A o Saulo, o Paulo foi lea, ua tumu o ia i le Agaga Paia, ua pulatoa ia te ia,

verses.en: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
verses.sm: ona faapea atu lea o ia, “O oe na ua tumu i le pepelo uma ma le ulavale uma, O le atalii o le tiapolo, o le “ino'ino i le amiotonu uma lava; e te le seʻi soia ea lou faapiopio i ala tonu O le ALII?

verses.en: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
verses.sm: Faauta nei, o le a oo ia te oe le aao o le ALII, e tauaso oe, e te le vaai i le la seia se aso.” Ona pau loa lea ia te ia o le popogi ma le pouliuli; ona fealuai lea o ia, ma saili ni tagata e tafita‘i ia te ia.

verses.en: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ua iloa foi e le suikonesula le mea ua faia, ona faatuatua lea o ia, ua matua ofo i le a'oa'oga a le ALII.

verses.en: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ua tuuvaa atu Paulo ma lana au malaga i Pafo, ua oo i latou i Pereka i Pafulia; ua tuua foi i laua e Ioane, ua toe foi o ia i Ierusalema.

verses.en: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
verses.sm: Ua tuua foi Pereka e i laua, ona la oo lea i Anetioka i Pisitia, ua ulufale i laua i le sunako i le aso sapati, ua nonofo i lalo.

verses.en: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
verses.sm: Ua uma foi ona faitau i le tulafono ma perofeta, ona aau atu lea e ua pule i le sunako nisi ia te i laua, ua faapea atu, “Sema e, le au uso e, afai ua ia te oulua se upu faamafanafana i le nuu nei, ina fai mai ia.”

verses.en: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
verses.sm: Ona tu lea o Paulo i luga, ma talo atu lona lima, ua faapea atu, “Outou Isaraelu e, ma outou o E matatau i le Atua, faafofoga mai ia.

verses.en: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
verses.sm: O le Atua o lenei nuu o Isaraelu na filifilia e ia o tatou tama; ma ua faaeaina le nuu ina o aumau i latou i le nuu o Aikupito, ua ia ta‘ita‘i ese atu ai foi ia te i latou i le aao malosi.

verses.en: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
verses.sm: Ua ia onosai foi i a latou amio i le vao i ona tausaga pe fagafulu.

verses.en: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
verses.sm: Ua uma foi ona olopalaina e ia o nuu e fitu i le laueleele o Kanana, ona tuuina atu lea e ia o le laueleele e fai mo latou tofi i tausaga pe fa o selau ma le limagafulu.

verses.en: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
verses.sm: Ua mavae foi o ia mea, ona tuu atu lea e ia o faamasino mo i latou, e oo lava i le perofeta o Samuelu.

verses.en: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
verses.sm: Mulimuli ane ua latou faatoga i se tupu; ona tuu atu lea e le Atua ia te i latou o Saulo, le atalii o Kiso, o le tagata o le ituaiga o Peniamina, i tausaga e fagafulu.

verses.en: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
verses.sm: Ua na ave ese foi ia te ia, ona faatuina lea e ia o Tavita e fai mo latou tupu; ua ia molitino foi ia te ia, ua faapea ane, Ua ou maua Tavita le atalii o Iese, o le tagata e tusa ma lo‘u nei loto, na te faia o tea uma lava ou te manao i ai.

verses.en: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
verses.sm: O le aiga o lenei tagata ua faatuina ai e le Atua ia Isaraelu le Faaola o Iesu, pei ona folafolaina e ia.

verses.en: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
verses.sm: A o lei maliu mai o ia, ua tala‘i atu e Ioane le papatisoga o le salamo i le nuu o Isaraelu uma lava.

verses.en: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai Ioane a o faauma e ia lona faiva, O ai ea a‘u nei i o outou manatu? E le o ia aʻu nei. A e peitai, faauta mai, o loo mulimuli mai le tasi, ou te le aoga ona ou tatala i ona seevae.

verses.en: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
verses.sm: “Sema e, le au uso e, o fanau a sa Aperaato, atoa ma e o matatau i le Atua o ia te outou, ua molia mai le upu o lenei faaolataga ia te outou.

verses.en: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
verses.sm: Aua o i latou o e nonofo i Ierusalema, ma o latou alii, ina ua le iloa e i latou o ia, ma upua le au perofeta ua faitauina i lea sapati ma lea sapati, ua taunuu ai ia te i latou i lo latou faasala ia te ia.

verses.en: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
verses.sm: E ui lava ina ua le maua e i latou se mea e tatau ona oti ai o ia, a ua latou fai atu ia Pilato ia fasiotia o ia.

verses.en: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
verses.sm: Ua faaiu foi e i latou mea uma lava na tusia ia te ia, ona ave ifo lea e i latou ia te ia i le laau, ua tuu i le tuugamau.

verses.en: But God raised him from the dead:
verses.sm: A ua toe faatu mai le Atua ia te ia i e ua oti;

verses.en: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
verses.sm: e tele foi ni aso na iloa ai o ia e tagata na o ae ma ia nai Kalilaia i lerusalema; o ana molimau i latou i le nuu.

verses.en: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
verses.sm: Ua ma folafola atu “oi ia te outou lenei tala lelei: o le mea na folafolaina atu i o tatou tama,

verses.en: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
verses.sm: na faaoo lea e le Atua ia te i tatou o a latou fanau, i lona toe faatuina o Iesu; pei ona tusia foi i le salamo e lua, O loʻu Atalii oe, ua fanaua oe e aʻu i le aso nei.

verses.en: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
verses.sm: Ona ua toe faatuina mai o ia ia te ia i e ua oti, ia le toe foi atu lava i le mea e pala ai, o lea ua faapea ona fetalai mai ai o ia, Ou te foai atu ia te outou mea paia a Tavita ua ¡aamaoni lava.

verses.en: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.sm: O le mea foi lea ua fetalai mai ai o ia i le tasi salamo, E te le tuu atu lou tagata paia ia oo ii ai le pala.

verses.en: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
verses.sm: O Tavita foi, ina ua uma ona auauna i 12 finagalo o le Atua i lona lava tupulaga, ua moe o ia, ma ua faatasiina atu i ona tama, ua oo foi ia te ia le pala.

verses.en: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
verses.sm: A o le na toe faatuina mai e le Atua, ua le 00 ia te ia le pala.

verses.en: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
verses.sm: O lenei, sema e, le au usc e, ia owon iloa ua folafolaina ia te outou le faamagaloina o agasala ona o lenei tagata;

verses.en: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
verses.sm: o tagata uma foi o e faatuatua, e ta‘uamiotonuina i latou ia te ia i mea uma lava na le mafai ona ta‘uamiotonuina ai outou i le tulafono a Mcse.

verses.en: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
verses.sm: O lenei, ia outou, neʻi oo ia te outou le mea ua fai mai ai perofeta,

verses.en: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
verses.sm: O outou o e ino‘ino, ina vaai mai ia, ma ofo, ma mou ia; aua ou te faia lava e au se galuega i ona aso o outou, o le galuega e ui ina faamatalaina ai ia te outou e se rasi, tou te le talitonu i at.”

verses.en: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
verses.sm: Ua c i latou i fafo o le sunako, Ona faatoga atu lea e le au lotu ina ia folafolaina mai ia upu ia te i latou i le sapati atali.

verses.en: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.sm: Ua tuua le faapotopotoga, ona mulimuli lea ia Paulo ma Panapa o tagata e toatele o Iutaia, ma e ua lotu ua matatau i le Atua; ua la tautala atu, ma apoapoai ia te i latou, ina ia tumau i le alofa tunoa o le Atua.

verses.en: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le sapati ona tali o uma mai lea o le nuu e faalogo i le afioga a le Atua.

verses.en: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e Iutaia le motu o tagata, ona matua matatana lea o i latou, ma latou upu ese mai i mea ua fai atu ai Paulo, ua upu ese ma upu leaga ia te ia.

verses.en: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.sm: Ona faamalosi atu lea o Paulo ma Panapa, ua faapea atu, “Ua tatau lava ona muai folafolaina atu le afioga a le Atua ia te outou; a ua outou tetee mai i ai, ma ua ta'uleaogaina outou e outou i le ola faavavau, faauta, o le mea lea ma te liliu atu ai i tagata o nuu ese.

verses.en: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
verses.sm: Aua ua faapea ona poloai mai o le ALII ia te i matou, Ua ou tofia oe e fai ma malamalama o nuu ese, ina ia avea oe ma faaolataga e oo i tulu‘iga o le lalolagi.”

verses.en: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo tagata o nuu ese, ona olioli ai lea, ma vivii atu i le afioga a le ALII; ua faatuatua foi i latou uma lava e ua saunia i le ola faavavau.

verses.en: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
verses.sm: Ua logo atu foi le afioga a le ALII i lea nuu uma lava.

verses.en: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
verses.sm: A ua faalalo ane e Iutaia i fafine e matatau i le Atua, ma saʻo tamaitai, ma saʻo alii o le aai, ma latou faatupu le sauaga ia Paulo ma Panapa, ma tutuli atu ia te i laua i o latou tuaoi.

verses.en: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
verses.sm: A ua tutu atu e i laua le eleele nai o laua vae ia te i latou, ona o atu ai lea o i laua i Ikonio.

verses.en: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
verses.sm: Ua tutumu foi le au soo i le olioli ma le Agaga Paia. O le saua na oo ia
